q1_issues.issue: The plural "crates" is typed as a single individual crate on the group symbol, so the several crates collapse into one entity and no group of crates is ever introduced.
Crates and lemons share one symbol, so the containment the "of"-phrase states (lemons in crates) is unrecoverable and the lemons get no entity of their own.
"several" counts the crates, but the CardinalityPhrase sits on the symbol whose GroupOf member-kind is lemon, so the atom asserts several lemons rather than several crates.

q2_gaps: container / packaging pseudo-partitive NP ("several crates of lemons", like "a cup of water"): the instruction set names measure-of phrases only to exclude them from Possession, its Partitives section fires only on a definite "of the / of these / of them" superset, and Measures & units covers only magnitude + unit, so a counted container noun plus its contents has no stated encoding
notes: The event layer (chef as Agent, the surface lemma acquire kept, Theme for the unchanged goods, Past) is correct; the defect is confined to the object NP. The shape chosen mirrors the licensed "a flock of birds" pattern (Member + GroupOf on one symbol), but that pattern has a singular collective head, whereas here the head noun is plural and independently counted.
